name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — 1 Basic — Dedicate the Chantry

system.description: Walking a counterclockwise circle around a building's grounds while sprinkling stagnant water, then anointing the lowest floor, you consecrate the site as a proper chantry. Any subsequent site ward or enchantment (such as Deny the Intruder) cast over dedicated ground gains a one-Trait bonus to completion.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
